poolIdentification.note: Global is bound to the diversion-manager lifecycle and serializer; eligibility excludes its tracked units. No generic invulnerability/cheat interpretation is assumed.

capitalCityIdentification.note: Serializer receives global+0x0c, walks16 entries at this+0x18 and names each capitolCityID. Eligibility walks the same global+0x24 array and excludes the actor at each City+0x3c. Ordinary non-capital city centers are not excluded by this specific check.
